description: Counts of recorded stablecoin blacklistings, freezes and seizures — by coin, by blockchain, by month, or by year. Answers questions like "how many wallets has Tether blacklisted", "which coin is frozen most often", and "how many seizures happened in 2025". Returns counts and dates only; no wallet addresses are returned by this tool.

chain.description: Optional blockchain name or chain id, e.g. Ethereum or 1.

group_by.description: Which breakdown to return. Defaults to token.

limit.description: How many coins the by-coin breakdown returns, the coins with the most recorded events first. Defaults to 20, up to 200. The totals count every coin whatever the limit. The other breakdowns are short and are returned whole.

token.description: Optional coin ticker, e.g. USDT. A ticker two issuers use returns both coins, each with its issuer. Omit for every coin.

name: get_token_statistics
title: Stablecoin blacklist and freeze statistics
